blocks.text: Have you ever wondered why services are different from products? Services have unique characteristics that set them apart.

blocks.markdown: Services are intangible, meaning they cannot be touched or owned. They are also inseparable, as production and consumption occur simultaneously. Variability refers to the differences in service quality, while perishability indicates that services cannot be stored for later use. Understanding these characteristics is crucial for effective marketing.

blocks.title: Key Characteristics of Services
blocks.text: The four main characteristics of services are: Intangibility, Inseparability, Variability, and Perishability.

blocks.markdown: In addition to the four characteristics, services marketing also includes the extra 3Ps: People, Process, and Physical Evidence. For instance, a bank uses trained staff (People), specific procedures for transactions (Process), and a well-designed branch (Physical Evidence) to enhance customer experience.

blocks.title: Analyzing a Bank's Service Marketing
blocks.prompt: Identify how a bank utilizes the 3Ps in its service marketing.

steps.text: 1. Identify the people involved: bank tellers and customer service representatives.
2. Describe the process: customers fill out forms and wait for their turn to be served.
3. Explain the physical evidence: the bank's interior, branding, and online presence.

blocks.answer: A bank uses trained staff to assist customers (People), has a systematic process for transactions (Process), and maintains a professional appearance (Physical Evidence).

blocks.markdown: From a customer's perspective, service quality can be evaluated based on reliability, responsiveness, assurance, empathy, and tangibles. For example, a customer may judge a restaurant's service quality by how quickly they are served and the friendliness of the staff.

blocks.title: Key Exam Tip
blocks.text: Remember to relate the characteristics of services to real-life examples in your answers.

points: Services are characterized by intangibility, inseparability, variability, and perishability.
The 3Ps (People, Process, Physical Evidence) are essential in service marketing.
